title: Bagong Pilipinas Merit Scholarship Program
description: The Bagong Pilipinas Merit Scholarship Program supports high-performing senior high school graduates who want to continue their education. It has two tracks: For the Higher Education Track, you must belong to the top five of your graduating class or have a Grade 12 general average of at least 95%. You must also meet the family income, course, and school requirements.

education.raw_text: The Bagong Pilipinas Merit Scholarship Program supports high-performing senior high school graduates who want to continue their education.

other_requirements: Higher Education Track: For incoming first-year college students taking an approved undergraduate degree at a qualified college or university.

requirements: TVET Diploma Track: For students taking a TESDA-approved diploma program at a registered technical-vocational school.

title: CHED Merit Scholarship Program
description: The CHED Merit Scholarship Program provides financial help to students with strong academic performance. You may apply if you are an incoming first-year college student and meet CHED’s grade, family income, course, and school requirements.

education.raw_text: You may apply if you are an incoming first-year college student and meet CHED’s grade, family income, course, and school requirements.

title: Expanding Access to Scholarships for Special Equity Groups
description: The EASE Program provides financial help to incoming first-year college students who belong to a special equity group. You may qualify if you are a person with a disability, a solo parent or their child, an Indigenous person, a senior citizen, or a qualified underprivileged student.

education.raw_text: The EASE Program provides financial help to incoming first-year college students who belong to a special equity group.

title: Scholarship Program for Coconut Farmers and Their Families
description: The Scholarship Program for Coconut Farmers and Their Families, also called CoScho, helps qualified coconut farmers and their dependents complete an undergraduate degree. You may apply if you are a Filipino citizen with a grade average of at least 80%, and you or your qualified family member is registered in the National Coconut Farmers Registry System. Your parents’ combined annual income must not exceed ₱300,000, and you must meet the course and school requirements.

education.raw_text: The Scholarship Program for Coconut Farmers and Their Families, also called CoScho, helps qualified coconut farmers and their dependents complete an undergraduate degree.

income.raw_text: Your parents’ combined annual income must not exceed ₱300,000, and you must meet the course and school requirements.

title: Scholarship Program for Future Medical Technologists and Pharmacists
description: The MTP-SP provides financial help to qualified students taking Medical Technology, Medical Laboratory Science, or Pharmacy. However, CHED has paused the acceptance of new scholars for Academic Year 2026–2027 under CEB Resolution No. 102-2026. You may monitor the official CHED page for any future application announcement.

title: Scholarship Program for Future Statisticians
description: The CHED Scholarship Program for Future Statisticians, also called Estatistikolar, supports students taking Bachelor of Science in Statistics or Bachelor of Science in Applied Statistics. You may apply if you are an incoming first-year or current college student and meet CHED’s academic, income, school, and course requirements.

education.raw_text: You may apply if you are an incoming first-year or current college student and meet CHED’s academic, income, school, and course requirements.

title: Agricultural Competitiveness Enhancement Fund Grants-in-Aid for Higher Education Program
description: The ACEF-GIAHEP supports students taking courses connected to agriculture and food production. Accepted areas may include agriculture, forestry, fisheries, veterinary medicine, and other related courses listed in the guidelines. You may apply if you are a Filipino citizen and your parents’ or guardians’ combined annual income does not exceed ₱400,000. You must also enroll in an approved course and must not be receiving another government-funded student assistance program.

title: Scholarship Program for Sugarcane Industry Workers, Small Sugarcane Farmers, and Their Dependents
description: The SIScholar Program provides financial help to qualified sugarcane industry workers, small sugarcane farmers, and their dependents who will take an approved course at a State University or College. You may apply as an incoming first-year college student if you have at least an 85% senior high school average, meet the ₱500,000 family income limit, and are certified by the Sugar Regulatory Administration.

education.raw_text: The SIScholar Program provides financial help to qualified sugarcane industry workers, small sugarcane farmers, and their dependents who will take an approved course at a State University or College.

title: DOST-SEI Science and Technology Undergraduate Scholarships
description: The DOST-SEI Undergraduate Scholarships support incoming first-year college students who will take an approved science and technology course. The program has two scholarship types: You must pass the DOST-SEI scholarship examination and meet the course, school, and other requirements.

education.raw_text: The DOST-SEI Undergraduate Scholarships support incoming first-year college students who will take an approved science and technology course.

other_requirements: Merit Scholarship: For students with strong ability in science and mathematics.
RA 7687 Scholarship: For talented students from families who meet the program’s financial requirements.

title: BEST for IP Scholarship Program
description: The BEST for IP Scholarship Program supports incoming first-year Indigenous students who want to take science and technology courses at Nueva Vizcaya State University. You may apply if you are a natural-born Filipino, an officially recognized member of an Indigenous Peoples group, and your household’s annual income does not exceed ₱400,000. You must also meet the other DOST-SEI requirements.

title: Education for Development Scholarship Program
description: The EDSP is for qualified children or siblings of active OWWA-member Overseas Filipino Workers taking a four-year or five-year college course.. If you are an incoming first-year student, you will apply under EDSP Category 1 and take the DOST national qualifying examination. Only the top 1,000 qualifiers are considered, while Category 2 is for students already enrolled in their second to fifth year of college.

education.raw_text: The EDSP is for qualified children or siblings of active OWWA-member Overseas Filipino Workers taking a four-year or five-year college course..

title: OFW Dependent Scholarship Program
description: The ODSP provides financial help to qualified dependents of active OWWA-member OFWs taking an associate, four-year, or five-year college course in the Philippines.. If you are an incoming first-year college student, you will apply under ODSP Category 1. Your OFW parent’s monthly income must meet the limit set by OWWA for the current application period.

education.raw_text: The ODSP provides financial help to qualified dependents of active OWWA-member OFWs taking an associate, four-year, or five-year college course in the Philippines..

title: Congressional Migrant Workers Scholarship Program
description: The CMWSP helps qualified migrant workers or their immediate dependents who will take an approved science and technology course. You may use the grant for a four-year or five-year college degree at a college or university in the Philippines.

education.raw_text: You may use the grant for a four-year or five-year college degree at a college or university in the Philippines.

title: Education and Livelihood Assistance Program
description: ELAP is not a general scholarship for every OFW dependent. The ELAP provides education and livelihood assistance to qualified dependents of OFWs facing serious family circumstances. You may qualify if your OFW family member died while actively registered with OWWA, or was incarcerated, convicted, or sentenced to death abroad and had at least one OWWA membership contribution.

title: Iskolar ng LANDBANK
description: Iskolar ng LANDBANK supports qualified children or grandchildren of agrarian reform beneficiaries, small farmers, and fisherfolk. You must take an approved course and apply through one of LANDBANK’s partner universities. The program may provide up to ₱100,000 per school year for allowances, books, uniforms, and other course needs.

title: GSIS Subsidy for Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics Program
description: The GSSP helps qualified children or dependents of eligible GSIS members study an approved STEM course. Your qualified GSIS-member parent may nominate you if they are in Salary Grade 15 or below and have updated premium payments. You must have at least a 90% senior high school average, no failing grades, and admission to an approved school and STEM course.

education.raw_text: You must have at least a 90% senior high school average, no failing grades, and admission to an approved school and STEM course.

title: Program to Monitor: GSIS Educational Subsidy Program
description: The GSIS Educational Subsidy Program has provided financial help to qualified dependents of GSIS members in previous years. Keep it in a separate “program to monitor” section unless GSIS releases a new application call. Do not describe it as open based only on an old announcement.

title: Fisheries Industry Leaders Grant
description: The FILG supports graduating or graduate senior high school students who belong to their school’s honor roll. You may apply if you are a natural-born Filipino, no more than 25 years old, have at least an 80% grade average, and have not earned any college units.

age.raw_text: You may apply if you are a natural-born Filipino, no more than 25 years old, have at least an 80% grade average, and have not earned any college units.

education.raw_text: The FILG supports graduating or graduate senior high school students who belong to their school’s honor roll.

title: Fisherfolk Children Educational Grant
description: The FCEG supports students whose parent or guardian is a registered municipal fisherfolk. You may apply if you are a natural-born Filipino, no more than 25 years old, have at least an 80% grade average, and have not earned any college units.

age.raw_text: You may apply if you are a natural-born Filipino, no more than 25 years old, have at least an 80% grade average, and have not earned any college units.

education.raw_text: You may apply if you are a natural-born Filipino, no more than 25 years old, have at least an 80% grade average, and have not earned any college units.

title: Fisheries Scholarship Program for Indigenous Cultural Communities and Indigenous Peoples
description: This scholarship supports qualified Indigenous students who want to take Bachelor of Science in Fisheries. You may apply if you are a natural-born Filipino, no more than 25 years old, belong to an Indigenous group recognized by NCIP, and have at least a 75% grade average.

age.raw_text: You may apply if you are a natural-born Filipino, no more than 25 years old, belong to an Indigenous group recognized by NCIP, and have at least a 75% grade average.

title: NCIP Merit-Based Scholarship Program
description: The NCIP Merit-Based Scholarship Program provides financial support to qualified and deserving Indigenous students based on academic performance and the program’s screening process. You may apply if you are a recognized member of an Indigenous Cultural Community or Indigenous Peoples group and meet the current NCIP requirements.The NCIP Merit-Based Scholarship Program supports qualified Indigenous students who perform well in the program’s screening and ranking process.

title: NCIP Educational Assistance Program
description: The NCIP Educational Assistance Program provides limited financial help to qualified Indigenous students who need support with their education. You must be a recognized member of an Indigenous Cultural Community or Indigenous Peoples group and meet the requirements of your NCIP regional or provincial office.The NCIP Educational Assistance Program provides financial or educational support to qualified Indigenous students.

title: DAR Scholarship Program for Dependents of Agrarian Reform Beneficiaries
description: The DSP-DARBs supports qualified dependents of agrarian reform beneficiaries who want to complete an approved agriculture-related college course. You may apply through a DAR provincial office or a participating State University or College, subject to the current program requirements.

education.raw_text: The DSP-DARBs supports qualified dependents of agrarian reform beneficiaries who want to complete an approved agriculture-related college course.

title: Davao City Water District College Scholarship Programs
description: Davao City Water District offers two main college scholarship programs: You must be an eligible resident of Davao City and meet the academic, financial, and other requirements of your chosen program.

education.raw_text: Davao City Water District offers two main college scholarship programs:

title: Iskolar sang Iloilo Program
description: The Iskolar sang Iloilo Program helps qualified but financially challenged students from Iloilo Province complete a four-year or five-year college course. You must be a resident of Iloilo Province and meet the grade, family income, school, and other requirements in the current announcement.

education.raw_text: The Iskolar sang Iloilo Program helps qualified but financially challenged students from Iloilo Province complete a four-year or five-year college course.

title: CP-GIFTS Scholarship Program
description: The CP-GIFTS Scholarship Program provides educational assistance to qualified incoming first-year college students from Cebu Province. You must meet the program’s grade, residency, family income, and school requirements. Applications may require endorsement or processing through the Office of the Governor, Office of the Vice Governor, or members of the Provincial Board.

education.raw_text: The CP-GIFTS Scholarship Program provides educational assistance to qualified incoming first-year college students from Cebu Province.

title: Comprehensive Assistance Program for Identified Scholars of Capiz
description: The CAPIS Scholarship Program provides educational assistance to qualified students from Capiz Province. It has three scholarship categories: You must meet the grade, residency, family income, school, and other requirements of the category you are applying for.

other_requirements: Merit Scholarship Program: For incoming first-year college students with strong academic performance.
Educational Financial Assistance Program: For incoming or current college students who need financial help, with priority given to selected groups.
EVAFFIT Scholarship Program: For students taking approved courses in Environmental Management, Veterinary Medicine, Agriculture, Fisheries, or Forestry.

title: Medical Scholarship and Return Service Program
description: The MSRS Program provides financial support to qualified students taking a Doctor of Medicine degree. It is not intended for regular incoming first-year undergraduate students. You may apply as an incoming first-year medical student if you have completed an approved pre-medical degree, passed the NMAT, and met the admission requirements of a participating medical school. Scholars must complete the required return service after graduation and licensure.

education.raw_text: It is not intended for regular incoming first-year undergraduate students.

title: Cash Grant to Medical Students Enrolled in State Universities and Colleges
description: The CGMS-SUCs provides tuition support and financial assistance to Filipino students taking a Doctor of Medicine degree in an approved State University or College.

education.raw_text: The CGMS-SUCs provides tuition support and financial assistance to Filipino students taking a Doctor of Medicine degree in an approved State University or College.

title: Northern Samar Provincial Medical Scholarship Program
description: The program supports qualified Northern Samar residents who plan to study Medicine and serve the province after completing their training. You may check this scholarship if you are preparing to enter medical school and are willing to complete the required return service.
